summary: The getent module runs getent against a system database and stores results as getent_<database> facts; not all databases support enumeration.
questions: How do I look up a user's passwd entry with Ansible?
Where does getent put its results?
Can I list all entries in a getent database?

answer_card.title: Query system databases with getent
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.getent` runs `getent` and stores results in facts named `getent_<database>` (e.g. `getent_passwd`). Not all databases support enumeration.
